mapper.sql: id, warning_no, rule_id, warning_level, category, sub_category, region, county_code, county_name, street_code, street_name, address_detail, is_broad, department, trigger_time, status, review_time, related_attention, ai_summary, measure, ref_cases, respond_status, respond_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warning_record (warning_no, rule_id, warning_level, category, sub_category, region, county_code, county_name, street_code, street_name, address_detail, is_broad, department, trigger_time, status, review_time, related_attention, ai_summary, measure, ref_cases, respond_status, respond_time) VALUES (#{warningNo}, #{ruleId}, #{warningLevel}, #{category}, #{subCategory}, #{region}, #{countyCode}, #{countyName}, #{streetCode}, #{streetName}, #{addressDetail}, #{isBroad}, #{department}, #{triggerTime}, #{status}, #{reviewTime}, #{relatedAttention}, #{aiSummary}, #{measure}, #{refCases}, #{respondStatus}, #{respondTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM warning_record WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE warning_record SET status = #{status}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, dept_sent_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SENT' THEN #{reviewTime} ELSE dept_sent_time END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE warning_record w SET w.respond_status = 'RESPONDED', w.respond_time = NOW() WHERE w.id = #{warningId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM warning_street_dispatch d WHERE d.warning_id = w.id AND d.respond_status = 'UNRESPONDED' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, warning_no, warning_level, category, sub_category, region FROM warning_record WHERE status = 'SENT' AND respond_status = 'UNRESPONDED' AND warning_level = 'URGENT' AND trigger_time <= #{threshold}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_record WHERE status = 'SENT' AND respond_status = 'UNRESPONDED' AND warning_level = 'URGENT' AND trigger_time <= #{threshold}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_record WHERE status = 'SENT' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{dept}, department) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(CONCAT(#{countyCode}, ':', #{dept}), department) > 0) AND respond_status = 'UNRESPONDED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_record WHERE warning_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
